units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:8">B. Bath. X, 8</cite>, a. e. <he>לא על אֱמוּנָתוֹ הלוהו</he> at the time he extended the loan, he did so not because he was relying on his (the friend’s) surety.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:8">Ib.</cite> <he>שכן על א׳ וכ׳</he> for in this case he did &c.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 55a:5">Ab. Zar. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>אנו נאבד את אֱמוּנָתֵנוּ</he> shall we abandon our honesty? <cite ref="Chullin 133b:4">Ḥull. 133ᵇ</cite> <he>אין א׳ בכותים</he> Samaritans are (usually) not trusted.
<cite ref="Tamid 28a">Tam. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ יתירה</he> scrupulous honesty. V. <cite ref="A02041"><he>אֲמָנָה</he></cite>.
